atoms.a: There were <mat>25</mat> questions in the maths test. Jimmy answered 18 correctly. What percentage of the questions did he answer correctly?
In a farm there are 34 animals made up of three kinds of animal. There are 12 pigs, 5 cows, and the rest are chickens. What percentage of animals on the farm are chickens?
In a bakery there are 120 pastries and 36 of them are croissants. What percentage of the pastries are croissants?
In a cat shelter there are 50 cats. 7 of them are ginger. What percentage of the cats are ginger?
On TV, there are 460 programmes a day. 207 of these are comedies. What percentage of the programmes are comedies?
